key_insight: The paper presents an uncertainty-aware workflow that combines data-driven prediction and physics-based filtering to rank ionic liquid candidates reliably for CO2 capture.
engineering_relevance: This enables more trustworthy screening of synthesizable ionic liquids in sparse, noisy, and out-of-distribution regimes, helping prioritize candidates with balanced solubility, viscosity, and working capacity.
method: Train deep learning property models for ionic liquids with uncertainty estimation.
Link prediction outputs to physics-based calculations and filtering criteria.
Select Pareto-optimal candidates for CO2 capture from flue gas.
evidence_signal: The workflow is demonstrated on novel ionic liquids, using predicted properties and Pareto-based selection across CO2 solubility, viscosity, and working capacity.
watch_item: Performance may still depend on sparse and uneven training data, so uncertainty estimates and rankings should be validated carefully before experimental synthesis.
paper_title: Comprehensive Workflow for Uncertainty-Aware Ionic Liquid Solvent Discovery
